method: Read every source line in bounded numbered chunks; leading indentation trimmed for display only. No compiler code edits.
reviewedDecisions: Concrete struct/enum definitions retain canonical field order and LLVM types; generic cycle visitation prevents recursive inspection loops, while separate semantic/layout validation owns illegal by-value cycles.
Struct/product/contextual initialization evaluates fields and copies fixed borrowed storage; whole-owner and projected moves are recorded separately, leaving sibling cleanup live.

Named reference places preserve existing references, mutable slots, capture-borrow pointers and canonical readonly root pointers. Field places recurse using exact declared field indexes and load stored references.
Array/slice reference places check unsigned bounds before pointer creation; dictionary references check slot presence and unwrap stored reference values.
Aggregate materialization/dematerialization retain builtin, nominal, reference, fixed/dynamic/bounded collection, task, stream and bitset ABIs. Unsupported representations fail explicitly.
Canonical numeric types preserve Int32 and target-width Size/UIntSize, and stream handles retain context/next/drop three-pointer storage.
